paradigm_inversion.analogy: Ray trace = pulling. Shadow cast = pushing. Gaia RADIATES, gates ABSORB.
paradigm_inversion.new: Shadow Casting — cast FROM the light (GPU) TO surfaces (displays). The GPU IS the sun.
paradigm_inversion.inversion: Don't ask what you see. CAST what you are. The render IS the organism radiating.
paradigm_inversion.old: Ray Tracing — trace rays FROM camera TO scene (ask the world what it looks like)
technical: Each display/client = a shadow surface at an angle
Instead of per-pixel ray queries, pre-compute light volumes and CAST them
Angular shadows = different clients see different projections of the same light
Inverting the image paradigm: not 'what does the camera see' but 'what does the light illuminate'
